scripts.verify: npm run -s check:contracts && npm run -s check:agent && npm run -s check:bot && npm run -s check:web && echo && echo 'VERIFY PASSED: contracts, agent, bot and web'
scripts.check:contracts: cd contracts && ([ -d node_modules ] || npm ci --legacy-peer-deps) && npx hardhat test
scripts.check:agent: cd agent && ([ -d node_modules ] || npm ci) && npm run typecheck && npm test
scripts.check:bot: cd bot && ([ -d node_modules ] || npm ci) && npm run typecheck && npm test
scripts.check:web: cd web && ([ -d node_modules ] || npm ci) && npm test && npm run build
